title: workload_metrics plugin config
description: The `config` object of an enabled `workload_metrics` plugin, generated from ferrum-edge/ferrum-edge openapi.yaml at v0.9.21 (f9915358c8032214f4034a17c28cdf72d14006c3), component WorkloadMetricsConfig and every component it references. Do not edit: run ci/plugin_config_schemas.py. This is Edge's own configuration schema, governed by Edge's support policy (docs/versioning.md); the plugin catalog records when Edge requires it.

MeshTrustedHboneAssertors.description:
Trusted HBONE assertor allow-list shared by `mesh_authz`,
`workload_metrics`, and the injected
`_effective_mesh_authz_baggage_gates`. Both plugins admit it through one
parser, so this one schema is the contract for every copy. `null` (or
omission) selects the default `["ztunnel", "waypoint"]`; `[]` disables
baggage-derived identity entirely.

Whitespace is trimmed with Rust `str::trim` (Unicode `White_Space`)
before any comparison; the patterns spell that class out explicitly so
every JSON Schema regex dialect reads it the same way. A value that is
empty after trimming is refused.

asserts.description:
Exact SPIFFE IDs this assertor may assert and nothing
else — the inventory of workloads it actually fronts. An
empty array authorizes nothing. `null` is treated as
absent. Mutually exclusive with `scope`.

scope.description:
Explicit grant contract. `same_namespace` (the default
for every entry) permits only identities in the
assertor's own Kubernetes namespace; `mesh_wide` requires
`assertor` to be a full, exactly matched `spiffe://` ID,
permits any identity that clears the trust-domain gate,
and logs a warning at construction. Mutually exclusive
with `asserts`. `null` is treated as absent. Surrounding
whitespace is trimmed before the value is compared,
matching the `assertor` field's normalization; the
pattern rather than an `enum` is what expresses that.

assertor.description:
Bare service-account name (matches any peer whose SPIFFE path ends
with `/sa/<name>`) or full `spiffe://` SPIFFE ID (matches exactly)
identifying the peer this entry admits. Surrounding whitespace is
trimmed before matching.

WorkloadMetricsConfig.description:
Plugin: workload_metrics — Adds Istio / GAMMA-style workload identity
labels and Telemetry CRD tag overrides into transaction metadata, and
owns trace-context propagation for the mesh. The existing logging,
metrics, and OTel sinks pick these up via `TransactionSummary.metadata`
and `StreamTransactionSummary.metadata` without plugin-trait changes.

Auto-injected by mesh mode on every applicable topology; reserved
plugin id `__mesh_workload_metrics`. Standalone use is supported on
non-mesh gateways that want Istio-style workload labels in logs.

Runtime admission permits at most 32 distinct custom tag names across
`custom_tags`, `custom_header_tags`, and `custom_env_tags` combined. The
individual `maxProperties: 32` bounds remain for generated clients, but
the cross-property combined total cannot be expressed mechanically.
The same 32-name union bound applies across every effective instance
on a proxy, including potentially triggered instances. Names compose;
later instances win for values they stamp. Invalid root/field types
are construction errors; OptionalFailOpen warns and omits the instance.

allow_plaintext.description: Admit a cleartext http:// tracing provider URL (Zipkin url, Datadog agent_url, Lightstep collector_url, OpenTelemetry endpoint) whose host is not a loopback IP literal written as a dotted-quad 127.d.d.d or [::1]. Without it, such a provider fails construction when its exporter is built. Mesh injection writes `true` whenever a translated Istio Telemetry / MeshConfig provider uses http://, so in-cluster collectors keep working and the cleartext posture stays visible in the injected config. This cross-field rule is enforced at construction only.

node_id.description: Mesh node identifier attached to workload metadata.

topology.description: Mesh topology name attached to workload metadata.

namespace.description: Mesh namespace attached to workload metadata and used when deriving the default `service_name`.

labels.description:
Workload label hints, not arbitrary metadata injection. Workload
selects the first nonblank canonical-name, app.kubernetes.io/name,
app, k8s-app, or workload label, then the SPIFFE service account.
App selects app.kubernetes.io/name, app, or k8s-app; service selects
service.istio.io/canonical-name, service, or app. Both fall back to
workload, whose final fallback is unknown.

trust_domain_aliases.description: Additional SPIFFE trust domains accepted as equivalent to the workload's trust domain.

trusted_hbone_assertors.description:
Allow-list of identity-asserting infrastructure components whose
HBONE baggage `source.principal` may be trusted for workload
metrics source attribution. Bare service-account names match any
peer whose SPIFFE path ends with `/sa/<name>`; full SPIFFE IDs
match exactly. Default is `["ztunnel", "waypoint"]`. Explicit
empty array disables baggage-derived source attribution. Null
selects the default, as does omission.

The same `MeshTrustedHboneAssertors` schema and the same semantics
as the `mesh_authz` field of the same name — the two plugins share
ONE parser and ONE relation, so telemetry
attribution can never grant what authorization refused (issue
#4274). Refused baggage is stamped
`mesh.ignored_baggage=assertion_out_of_scope`.

sampling_percentage.description:
Tracing sampling percentage 0.0–100.0. Populated from Istio
`Telemetry.tracing.randomSamplingPercentage` and, as a baseline,
from `MeshProxyConfig.tracing_sampling` (Telemetry wins when both
are present). `ProxyConfig.spec.tracing.sampling` has no
counterpart in Istio's `networking.istio.io/v1beta1` ProxyConfig
CRD schema, so the Kubernetes API server prunes it and the
baseline arrives over native/file/xDS mesh config rather than the
CRD watcher. Non-numeric or out-of-range ProxyConfig / Telemetry
sampling values fail closed at Kubernetes translation.
Direct standalone omission leaves new roots unsampled; a valid
upstream W3C or B3 sampling decision is still inherited.

custom_tags.description:
Custom tags injected into transaction metadata and exported spans.
Names are limited to 128 ASCII letters, digits, `.`, `_`, or `-`
and cannot collide with reserved, sensitive, `mesh.*`, trace,
authorization keys, a reviewed gateway-published metadata key (for
example `grpc_full_method`, `consumer_username`, `namespace`), or a
built-in plugin's metadata namespace (`<plugin>.<key>` or
`<plugin>_<key>`, for example `ai_transcript_audit.record_id`). This map, `custom_header_tags`, and
`custom_env_tags` may contain at most 32 distinct tag names combined.
For Istio environment tags, values here are `defaultValue`
fallbacks only — live data-plane resolution uses `custom_env_tags`.

custom_header_tags.description:
Custom tags populated from request headers (`tag_name ->
header_name`). Credential-bearing source headers (including a
`pat` segment such as `x-pat` and a terminal `auth` segment such
as `x-basic-auth`) and reserved or sensitive destination names
are rejected; runtime values over 1024
bytes are omitted. Fail closed: a source header not declared in
`safe_tag_sources` is copied as `[REDACTED]`, never verbatim. This
map, `custom_tags`, and `custom_env_tags` may contain at most
32 distinct tag names combined.

custom_env_tags.description:
Istio `customTags.<tag>.environment` lookups (`tag_name ->
env_var_name`) resolved from the local data-plane process
environment at plugin construction and reload. Controllers must
not resolve these against the controller-host environment. A
present UTF-8 value overrides any matching `custom_tags` default;
a missing variable keeps that default when present and otherwise
omits the tag. Credential-bearing environment variable names
(including secret/password/token/key/credential names, the
metadata redactor's credential classes such as session
identifiers, passphrases/passcodes, PINs and one-time codes, JWTs,
signatures, private/signing key material and bearer assertions,
database connection locations, client credential identifiers, a
`PAT` segment such as `GITHUB_PAT`, a terminal `AUTH` segment such
as `BASIC_AUTH`, and operator-configured sensitive metadata names)
are rejected.
Non-UTF-8 or >1024-byte values fail construction closed. Values of
variables declared in `safe_tag_sources` are emitted as custom
transaction and trace metadata; any other variable is emitted as
`[REDACTED]` (fail closed). Diagnostics never include resolved
values or rejected credential-bearing variable names. This map,
`custom_tags`, and `custom_header_tags` may contain at most
32 distinct tag names combined.

safe_tag_sources.description:
Header names (case-insensitive) and environment variable names
(case-sensitive) whose values `custom_header_tags` and
`custom_env_tags` may copy verbatim. Every undeclared source is
copied as `[REDACTED]`. An entry that the credential classifiers
match (for example `x-session-id`, `GPG_PASSPHRASE`, `x-key-private`)
is rejected: a credential-shaped source cannot be declared safe.
Diagnostics name the entry index only.

metrics.description:
Istio Telemetry-CRD-style metrics customization. Both fields are
optional and additive. The object, each `tag_overrides` entry, and
each `operation` are closed: unknown fields, and fields belonging
to a different operation `type`, are rejected at construction.

metric.description:
Metric family targeted by this override. Supported values
are `REQUEST_COUNT`, `REQUEST_DURATION`, `REQUEST_SIZE`,
`RESPONSE_SIZE`, `TCP_OPENED_CONNECTIONS`,
`TCP_CLOSED_CONNECTIONS`, `TCP_SENT_BYTES`,
`TCP_RECEIVED_BYTES`, `GRPC_REQUEST_MESSAGES`,
`GRPC_RESPONSE_MESSAGES`, their matching `ferrum_mesh_*`
metric names, and `ALL_METRICS`; omitted means all
metrics, as does null. Other names fail direct plugin
construction. Istio translation separately warns and
omits recognized families Ferrum does not emit.

name.description:
Tag name to override. Accepts Istio names such as
`source_workload` and `grpc_response_status`, and Ferrum
`mesh.*` label names. TCP families never render
`response_code` or `grpc_response_status`. A
`response_code` value that is a status's canonical
decimal spelling shares that status's series.

operation.description:
One of `{"type": "remove"}`,
`{"type": "rename", "new_name": "..."}`,
`{"type": "set", "value": "..."}` (literal), or
`{"type": "set_expr", "cel": "..."}` /
`{"type": "set_expr", "expression": {...}}` (compiled
Telemetry UPSERT CEL). Expressions are compiled at
construction/reload; the metric hot path evaluates the
precompiled plan only. Supported CEL attributes are the
finalized mesh metric-key peer labels plus
`request.method`, `request.host`, `response.code`, and
`destination.port`. With several effective
`workload_metrics` instances, inputs are stamped from the
union required by the final composed per-family plans;
replacing one family also replaces that family's input
requirements. Exact CEL label values and ordinary mesh
identity series share a finite per-family live-series
budget configured on the global `prometheus_metrics`
plugin as `mesh_series_budget_per_family` (default
10_000, range 1–1_000_000); further distinct keys are
dropped and counted on
`ferrum_mesh_metric_series_overflow_total{family}` with
fixed family labels only. Stale TTL eviction releases
capacity. HTTP-only attributes are rejected for TCP /
`ALL_METRICS` selectors. Diagnostics never echo
expression text.

value.description:
Replacement tag value when `type` is `set`. OpenAPI
`maxLength` counts Unicode characters; runtime
admission separately enforces at most 256 UTF-8 bytes,
so multibyte values may be rejected below 256
characters.

cel.description:
Bounded CEL source when `type` is `set_expr`. Set
exactly one of `cel` and `expression`. Limits:
512 UTF-8 bytes including surrounding whitespace, 32
tokens, nesting depth 8, 24 AST nodes. Supported
forms: attribute reads,
`string(<int attribute>)`, and
`has(<string attribute>) ? <then> : <else>`.
OpenAPI `maxLength` counts Unicode characters;
runtime admission separately enforces the 512-byte UTF-8 limit,
so a multibyte expression can be rejected
below 512 characters.

expression.description:
Precompiled CEL AST produced by Telemetry translation
/ materialization (`op`: `literal`, `attribute`,
`string_of_int`, `has_then_else`).

tag_overrides.description:
Ordered per-metric tag overrides translated from the Istio
Telemetry CRD. Runtime admission accepts at most 128 entries
and at most 16384 encoded bytes across the per-family plans
stamped into transaction metadata.

disabled_metrics.description:
Names of metrics suppressed by this workload. Supported values
are `REQUEST_COUNT`, `REQUEST_DURATION`, `REQUEST_SIZE`,
`RESPONSE_SIZE`, `TCP_OPENED_CONNECTIONS`,
`TCP_CLOSED_CONNECTIONS`, `TCP_SENT_BYTES`,
`TCP_RECEIVED_BYTES`, `GRPC_REQUEST_MESSAGES`,
`GRPC_RESPONSE_MESSAGES`, their matching `ferrum_mesh_*` metric
names, and `ALL_METRICS`. Other names fail direct construction;
Istio translation separately warns and omits recognized
families Ferrum does not emit.

tracing_providers.description:
Per-provider tracing exporters surfaced from the Istio Telemetry
CRD via the mesh slice. Also enables trace-context propagation
when span reporting is disabled. Present null or [] disables
exporters and overrides the singular fallback. A `zipkin`
provider also injects the active span as B3 (`x-b3-traceid`,
`x-b3-spanid`, `x-b3-parentspanid`, `x-b3-sampled`) beside W3C
`traceparent`; B3 is likewise refreshed from the active span
whenever the backend request still carries B3 headers, and the
single-header `b3` form is written when the request used it.
Spans an exporter refuses at enqueue or discards at delivery
(`reason="export_failed"`) are counted on
`ferrum_mesh_tracing_spans_dropped_total{provider,reason}` with
fixed labels only.

tracing_provider.description:
Singular tracing exporter fallback. Ignored when
`tracing_providers` is present. Omitted/null means no provider.

span_reporting_disabled.description:
When `true`, trace context is still propagated but no spans are
exported. Matches Istio Telemetry CRD `disableSpanReporting`.

service_name.description:
Service name attached to exported spans. Defaults to
ferrum-edge-mesh-<namespace> for a nonblank namespace, otherwise
ferrum-edge-mesh. Must be nonblank when exporters are active.

deployment_environment.description:
`deployment.environment` resource attribute stamped on exported
spans. Read by the shared OTel exporter options off this same
root config object.

batch_size.description:
Span export batch size. Read by the shared OTel exporter options
off this same root config object.

flush_interval_ms.description:
Span export flush interval in milliseconds. Read by the shared
OTel exporter options off this same root config object.

buffer_capacity.description:
Maximum buffered spans awaiting export. Read by the shared OTel
exporter options off this same root config object.

buffer_max_bytes.description:
Maximum retained bytes of buffered spans. Read by the shared OTel
exporter options off this same root config object.

max_retries.description:
Span export retry attempts. Read by the shared OTel exporter
options off this same root config object.

retry_delay_ms.description:
Delay between span export retries, in milliseconds. Read by the
shared OTel exporter options off this same root config object.

direction_emit.description:
Which traffic directions emit telemetry, translated from
`Telemetry.tracing[].match.mode`. Omitted/null defaults to
server-only. Unknown nested fields are rejected.

_effective_mesh_authz_baggage_gates.description:
Internal mesh-injection field: an exact copy of every enabled
global `mesh_authz` baggage gate, evaluated as a fail-closed
conjunction. Not operator-facing; direct instances configure
`trusted_hbone_assertors` / `trust_domain_aliases` instead.

customTagName.description:
Runtime additionally rejects reserved telemetry names and sensitive
names, including operator-configured classifiers. String/label
byte limits and cross-map/cross-instance unions are checked at
admission; JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode characters.

provider.description:
Direct provider envelope; name-only references belong to Istio
translation. The envelope and each `config` are closed: unknown
fields are rejected at construction. Active exporters
require an absolute HTTP(S) endpoint with a host and no embedded
credentials. Lightstep reads its bearer token from the named local
environment variable at construction; the name must be
`FERRUM_PLUGIN_SECRET_<NAME>` (`<NAME>` uppercase
`[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*`), and any other variable is refused at
admission even while span reporting is disabled. URL/header/token validation
and local environment availability are runtime checks. Exporter
ranges in the parent conditional apply only with at least one
selected provider and reporting enabled; inactive numeric options
still require unsigned integer types.

celExpression.description:
Compiled AST uses snake_case attribute names, unlike CEL source.
Runtime enforces depth <= 8, total nodes <= 24, literal values <=
256 UTF-8 bytes, and family-specific attribute availability.
Recursive shape is modeled here; aggregate node/depth and encoded
plan-byte budgets remain runtime admission checks.
